title: Antelope Reef could now be the largest island in the South China Sea — AMTI/CSIS
snippet: CSIS Asia Maritime Transparency Initiative — Updated satellite imagery assessment shows Antelope Reef land reclamation has made it potentially the largest island in the South China Sea. High-resolution commercial satellite imagery documents continued dredging and construction activity since initial reporting.
tag_reason: Update to existing Antelope Reef event (src-007/ent-evt-006); AMTI/CSIS provides updated assessment showing further expansion.
